chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim said: al-Nakha'i, Abu al-Husayn, narrated to me. He said: 'Ubayd ibn al-Harith narrated to me, from Hammad al-Minqari, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said to me: 'If you want to increase your wealth, then lengthen your standing at al-Safa.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker in this narration
key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, the well-known sacred place in the rites of hajj and 'umrah
key_terms.الْوُقُوفَ: standing or remaining at a sacred place in worship

ai.seo_question: How does standing longer at al-Safa relate to increase in wealth according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a saying of Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام encouraging prolonged standing at al-Safa. It presents this devotional act, associated with worship during hajj, as a means connected with increase in wealth.
